Her excuse was that she assumed I wanted a chihuahua cut because all her other clients who have Yorkies ask for them to be bald. This had nothing to do with my dog and she refused to take responsibility for her mistake. I do not recommend her I don’t you have the same experience that I had.

Horrible experience for myself and my dogs. First the place is dirty that’s why they don’t allow anyone pass the grooming door. I took both my dogs to get groomed an American bully and 1 year old frenchie, I gave them our number to call once ready they said it will take 3 hours I said ok, I don’t live in the area but took my dogs there from seeing the good reviews. I get there after the 3 hours wondering why no one called me for pick up once inside the owner said I have to get my dogs out the cage that they won’t allow no one to get them out. I go to the back the lady groomer said my dogs were growling I asked which one she said the frenchie I went to take my dogs out and seen they never even bathe them their reasoning was the puppy frenchie was growling he’s a damn baby if you’re scared of a puppy you shouldn’t be working with dogs. So I asked what about my bully why wasn’t she bathe didn’t get an answer for that!! They had my dogs in dirty cages for 3 hours said they called me I asked what number did you call cause I never received a call they took down the wrong number this whole ordeal was a watch of time!! They had my bully in a cage that was to small with her leash still on attached to the cage she was so uncomfortable and scared, my frenchie was shaking scared. I take my dogs to petsmart for grooming never had a problem, I figured I can try this place a local moms and pop shop to support a small business NEVER AGAIN!! Also petsmart is cheaper!!!

So first off, the store itself great. From clothes in different sizes to dog food brands that are not just pedigree or purina. There are so many choices in terms of toys and treats.
I can't say the same for the grooming. For starters, I told them not to make my dog bald and leave some hair, but they did the exact opposite. My dog looks like a potato and even more like a boy dog than before. But, hair can grow back and that's minor problem compared to the bigger problem.
My dog came from there very stressed. I don't know what they did, but apparently she was extremely aggressive which NEVER happened with any other groomers I took her to. For reference, my dog is very calm when it comes to taking baths, cutting her nails, and blow drying. And, before I even picked her up, I overheard one of the groomers yelling at the dogs. When I came to get her, she was all the way in the back of a cage while the door was wide open before she saw me.
I had to pay extra due to her aggressive behavior, but I have reason to believe that they made her feel unsafe somehow. By the way, this is all alleged. I don't have proof but there is a lot leading to this theory.
As much as I wanna give the benefit of the doubt that maybe I'm overthinking it, I don't think I'm taking her there for grooming ever again. I really wanted to give a good review because a good friend recommended me this place, but it is what it is I guess
